verdict.rationale: ZCode documents a Goal feature for continuously planning, executing and verifying long multi-step work, and lets users remotely trigger tasks via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram, so delegated longer-running work is plausible. Execution appears to happen locally or on user-supplied SSH/WSL hosts. Community advice to wrap it in sandbox-exec or a separate user account suggests there is no built-in isolation. missing for 10: any managed isolated cloud execution environment, documented background or asynchronous task running detached from the local machine, sandboxing or isolation guarantees, hands-on corroboration of background delegation.
